rows.jyutping: zung2 zuk6 kei4 si6 ge3 jan4
rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial way to refer to a person who is racist.

example.english: They always say some races are inferior; they’re really a racist.
example.traditional: 佢成日話某啲種族低人一等，真係種族歧視嘅人。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 waa6 mau5 di1 zung2 zuk6 dai1 jan4 jat1 dang2 zan1 hai6 zung2 zuk6 kei4 si6 ge3 jan4
